annotations.title: Can shopping agents find this brand? (free)

description: Free check of a brand's website: can Meta Muse, Grok and ChatGPT open it, read its products (price, currency, stock, image) and pick the store? Returns a 0-100 score per engine, a prioritized fix list and the brand plans. Use when a person or brand asks whether AI shopping agents can find or recommend their store, or before get_brand_plan_checkout.

domain.description: The brand's domain or URL, e.g. yourbrand.com.
